title: Great product, but room for improvement on packaging front!
review: There is not doubt that d-mannose is a great product (at least for me). Every since I was recommended the product by a specialist of the medical profession, my urinary track infection (UTI) have been an issue of the past. I have tried the powder and pill forms and pills work the best for me (especially because I travel a lot). Anyway, the reason I have given only a three star rating is due to the packaging the pills come in. When I started taking d-mannose about five years ago, the pills were sold in small resealable plastic bags. Now the pills are sold in plastic tubs which does not work for me at all for various reasons:- Once I start a new tub (remove the foil of the top), the pills are very prone to attract moisture and get soft. This might not happen to quickly at home, but in other environments such as taking them to work and leisure activities, camping, backpacking, etc. - Having one of the d-mannose tubs in your handbag (or rucksack) is like carrying a rattle due the the noise the pills make in the hard plastic tub.- I simply do not like excessive packaging. I would have stopped buying this product after the change in packaging if it wasn't working so well for my frequent UTIs. There is no need to waste resources on producing a sturdy hard plastic tub if a little resealable bag does the job! Due to the first two issues mentioned above, as soon as I open a new tub now I transfer all the pills into a resealable plastic bag (actually one of the old d-mannose bags I still had kicking about). This means that the hard plastic tubs end up in the bin (and therefore a burden to the environment) as soon as I receive a delivery of d-mannose pills. Great product, but please put them back in the old packaging!!!!

title: The liaison Karl was really good
review: The liaison Karl was really good , very attentive and helpful at every step. I felt a little rushed by the doctor at the clinic, which wasn’t fun , he focused more on the front of my head rather than the sides but the sides are where it was thinking so there are parts on the side of my head that he didn’t do even though I told him that was my main concern. it felt as if he didn’t want to take too long on me, even though I had spent so much to get my desired results. The hairline isn’t exactly what I wanted but my results are looking quite good, it’s exactly 2 weeks today since I got it done and I’m very excited to see how it turns out. Over all I would say it is worth it but dont let the doctor rush you, learn from my mistake, take your time to describe your desired hairline , you’ve spent allot you deserve 100% what you want.

title: Great Company to choose
review: On doing my research into hair transplants I looked at a lot companies and did my research. Now Cosmetics has a great website and were very supportive and helpful. They answered all my questions and were supportive and not pushy. They knew what they were talking about and offered the best treatment at the very best price. I had to travel for my transplant and I had been given good information from the Now Cosmetics team but I expected contact from the clinic a few days prior, I had a call the evening before and then another later that evening. They weren’t as on top of it as I had hoped, they told me I couldn’t wear a pull over my head top which hadn’t been mentioned before. I hadn’t packed one which was a worry, on arrival they were friendly and the clinic was very clean. The Doctor tried to get me to change my mind on what I wanted but I had been advised to not agree until I was happy. I was glad Now Cosmetics Gave me that advice because it felt like the clinic wanted me to go with something I didn’t want but after I made my decision it was go. After the procedure which was carried out really well, staff were lovely and caring, the doctor advised I upgrade and not have plasma which was part of my package. I had just had 7 hours of hair transplant and didn’t know anything about this upgrade so agreed as he said it would work best. £500 later I feel like I should have stuck with the plasma but it was my decision. I would have preferred to have had that offer at the start or being informed by Now Cosmetics as after the procedure wasn’t the best time to ask me. The aftercare by Now Cosmetics has been fantastic, the pictures they request and the advice and phone calls they give to get you through it shows they actually care. Any queries or worries you have they are more than happy to assist and help. It’s 8 weeks today and I can see and feel the hair starting to come through.I did this as I felt I didn’t want to have a receding hair line or a bald patch. I had a long hard think about it and I’m very happy I made the decision and I’m very happy at choosing Now Cosmetics. The London clinic was the only bit that I wasn’t fully happy with but the rest was brilliant.

title: Lopsided transplant and chaotic scenes in surgery
review: A disappointing experience, Karl was great but the actual transplant resulted in a patchy and irregular job. The whole process felt like you were in a factory line of transplants. Your hair was worked on by two different surgeons, one experienced and one not so. The result shows, one side is decent and as expected whilst the other is patchy and looks like dolls hair. The solution offered was a second transplant which isn't something I want to endure again. The day of surgery was chaotic, they didn't know who I was and the supposed surgeon I had wasn't there. I was also upsold on prp whislt under the knife which felt completely irresponsible as you're already in a state of shock and worry. All in all, good after care but that is irrelevant when you look at the actual transplant procedure being so poorly executed and managed on the day.

title: Clear communication and great prices
review: It is now two weeks since I have had my transplant with WantHair via the Manchester Deansgate clinic. Overall I have had a very positive experience. My hairline has been receding and I got nearly 3000 grafts packed into the front/temple areas. I can now see a lovely shaped hairline that will hopefully grow in thicker and fuller over the coming months. On the day of the procedure, the consultant talked through the entire procedure with me, what to expect and aftercare procedures which were also printed out and given to me. I appreciated that the consultant asked me what I was wanting from the surgery and designed the hairline to cater for what I wanted. The actual procedure itself wasn’t too bad. The injections to numb the head do really sting and it did bring me to tears – but this was more because of the adrenaline that was in my system rather than the actual pain of the injections. Once the injections were done it was plain sailing from there. Aftercare communication has been excellent, I was set up in a WhatsApp group with Logan and Becky and any question or worry I had was answered very quickly and promptly. I gave them daily pictures of the transplant and donor areas and they monitored my recovery. Whenever I required a little bit of reassurance or support they were always there to talk me down. If anything seemed unclear with post-op procedures they were there to help me understand anything I wasn’t sure of. I am sure like many who opt for a hair transplant, I was very anxious. The idea of getting my head shaved, putting yourself through pain, spending a lot of money with no guarantee of a great result is a nerve wracking experience. There have been moments throughout this experience where my anxiety has been raised slightly as I was provided with conflicting aftercare advice from the WantHair team and the actual clinic in Manchester. It is also clear from the WantHair Facebook group that others had different aftercare procedures from me. This has made me feel at times worried that I might not be following the “correct” advice. Some examples of this:-	I was provided with a spray bottle of water after my procedure and told to spray the transplanted area every 15 minutes with water. Others in the Facebook group were not told this needs to happen or provided with a spray bottle.  -	My post-op instructions from the Manchester clinic advised to avoid strenuous exercise for 2 weeks while WantHair team have told me 4 weeks. -	My post-op instructions from the Manchester clinic said no use of finasteride or minoxidil until week 6 post op, however WantHair have clearly told me that these treatments can resume from week 2. Overall, I would recommend Want Hair – excellent prices and clear communication. Providing consistent advice to patients is a small area of improvement. Thank you!

I wouldn’t recommend Want Hair based on my experience.

title: After one year, a very negative experience overall
review: So, it is now been almost one year since my HT.I have been very patient and compliant with all the aftercare recommendations.However, I regret having to write a negative review.First of all, I want to clarify that I am giving 1 star not as a substitute for a 0-star review. 1 star means that there have been some improvements, but way less than expected, and with some big downsides.I had 3100 grafts implanted at a clinic provided by WH (MyHair, in London), but there are some significant issues.I was promised full density in the front, and less in the crown. However, density is quite poor in both areas. The worst is the frontline, where in some areas density is particularly poor.The biggest problem is the design of the hairline. This is very poor. The line is too straight and appears clearly fake. Plus, for some strange reason, less grafts were implanted in the middle part. So, I have more density on the two sides and less in the centre. This is clear also from the post-op images, so it was clearly a design problem.In addition to this, there was a huge mistake that I would have never expected in 2023: the front hairline was implanted with mainly multi follicles grafts, which is an amateur mistake! What I have learnt - sadly too late - is that the front hairline should be made of one-hair follicles and soft hair, to make it look more natural. However, this wasn't done. This is clearly noticeable by people, and in a way it has made me even more self conscious than before the intervention, which is the opposite of what I paid for.I had to see a trichologist, who told me that a natural hairline has soft singles only, as doubles in the hairline makes it look like doll hair and stand out as a transplant; and that the techs should have sorted my grafts under a microscope, but my hairline has lots of doubles. They said that I will now need a repair to fix this.What this means is that I will now have to book a new intervention - a hair transplant restoration - to fix everything. Which means paying again a lot of money, but also having to take time off work and using my annual leave for the recovery.Furthermore, under strong light, it also appears that I have developed some degree of cobblestoning, which further contributes to the doll effect.With regards to the positive aspects, the advisor and doctor were nice and friendly. However, communication in general was not great. The clinic has never - and I mean not once - answered the phone or replied to any of my emails. The advisor was very supportive and communicative, but communication became much more inconsistent following the surgery, and they did never get back to me after the last email regarding some of the issues encountered.With regards to reports and information governance, the clinic did not share any report or document following the surgery, and I had to chase them up for weeks to get written information such as number of grafted, hair follicles, etc. However, I am not even sure this information was accurate, as nobody was taking any written note during the surgery, so I don't know how they would remember such details after weeks. Moreover, this information was not shared with an official document on headed paper from the doctor, but by emails which looked and sounded quite improvised, informal and lacking information.For example, they didn't share with me how many grafts were extracted, but only how many were implanted (some grafts can be damaged and lost). Which leads to another issue, as my donor area looks overharvested, with extraction grafts not following a pattern, hence leaving uneven visible patches with different density. This forces me to keep my hair longer to cover up, and it also concerns me because it might affect the possibility of having other interventions in the future. I bled quite a lot during the surgery, so now I am wondering if the size of the needle punch or the ability of the technician might have damaged surrounding grafts, causing permanent shock loss.To summarise, some positives but mainly negatives, which makes this a very negative experience overall.

title: Shipping is very fast communication is non existent
review: Shipping is very fast, communication is non existent. I received the package 2 days after the order (10ml pure black), there was no invoice in the jiffy pack just the product. After further investigation on the internet I discovered that through numerous trials the effective dose for helping with sleep issues is 75mg to 100mg which equates to 12 doses in the bottle, which isn't much for the price. https//startsleeping.org https//dailycbd.comI'm on the large size and weigh over 250lb so my recommend dose is 76mg.CBD brothers recommend starting at 18mg and not to exceed 70mg. The packaging has a moon and stars on it denoting it's aimed at nighttime use. I emailed CBD brothers to get some clarification on the matter of dosing and the research findings and had no response at all. I toyed with sending the product back but thought I would give it a try and can say that at over 70mg it helps to relax but doesn't stop me from waking up during the night. The effectiveness of the product is minimal and definitely not worth the price. In my opinion CBD brothers pure black is useless.I thought I would try the herbal route to help with sleep and now wish I'd bought some nytol (which works).

title: I booked a treatment for dark circle depigmentation
review: I booked a treatment for eye depigmentation and got treated with a laser. My treatment was excellent the first months, just till I stopped (treatments are not cheap), and my pigmentation came back now with a white spot near my lacrimal on my upper lid. When I asked about the treatment not being successful, I encountered "buts" and other reasons why it didn't work instead of setting up my expectations or explaining to me the possibility of not working from the beginning of the first consultation. I requested a return of my money or part of it, and the answer was no. I left it in the hands of Allah. After a few months, my vision was blurry, and I gradually recovered it.I started attending for a facial a lady who is an Aesthetic Practitioner who graduated from University College Birmingham. After a month, while asking her for treatments for the dark circles around my eyes and explaining to her my experience with the laser treatment, she pointed out my vision blurriness was a product of the laser light used for my dark circles as metal shields were not used and how I could have started a legal complaint for malpractice as the technician should have used an eye shield to protect my eyes during the treatment. I have gone legal due to the cost involved, but now I am leaving my review here. Hence, you, in the future, do your research, study the treatment scientifically proven, and ask many questions about complications during the first consultation. Know how laser therapies, chemical peels, and acne treatment should follow a procedure and not just trust what the technician says. Learn from the mistakes of others. Don't just rely on the name being known, cultural affinity or religious affinity; unfortunately, all doesn't matter regarding your health. Fast results don't mean good; play your part in searching and knowing. Do you know who is treating you? What is their background? Which training do they have?

review: Well presented and clean clinic in Birmingham but very underwhelmed with the consultation process for a hair transplant. I was then told that because I’m HIV+ Undetectable that their hospital in Turkey wouldn’t be able to facilitate my surgery, but instead would have to be seen at a larger facility outside of their control and at an increased cost. No explanation was given and the employee wasn’t able to justify this decision. There are no extra surgical concerns apart from a negligible risk of blood contamination/transfer, but any reputable surgery that’s following fully aseptic technique a shouldn’t have a problem with this? I was given a blanket price without an explanation of how many grafts would be needed and without the employee coming any closer than about 5m from me. Without inspecting the donor areas, planning out a potential hairline etc, how can the number of grafts and therefore an accurate price be given? Felt like a vague sales approach, rather than a proper clinical consultation which was a shame considering the reputation of this company. Was quoted around £5000 for treatment, around £800 for flights and accommodation and finally around £1200 for aftercare. At £7000 this is comparable to numerous UK based Senior Surgeons, so I don’t see the economical advantage of Turkey based survey when the cost isn’t competitive and the consultation process is pretty medically devoid it seemed.

title: WARNING: TREAD CAREFULLY
review: Read before spending your money. I'm currently a patient at Este Medical Group London, undergoing laser hair regrowth treatment including 2 sessions of PRP (platelet-rich plasma) injections. On the face of it, Este Medical Group seem professional, well organised and there is no doubt that their facilities are comfortable and welcoming. However, what quickly seems a positive experience can easily be undone when you raise an issue or have reason to make contact in order to resolve a problem.In my case, I outlaid £2,800.00 for laser hair regrowth treatment which includes 2 sessions of PRP and 6 months worth of 20 minute laser treatments, twice a week.I booked my consultation which was taken by (name removed), who seemed somewhat professional, however not a doctor and advised that I would benefit from laser regrowth treatment and my success rate would be amplified by 2 sessions of PRP. I was slightly taken aback by the £2,800.00 price tag on the treatments and this surprise was met by the comment 'this is the price to keep your hair', fairly abrupt, a little forceful in my opinion. The situation seemed somewhat forced like the product being sold (hard sold) was the only way forward to achieve my goal. My suggestion of paying over a period or per session was quickly denied and I was told that payment would have to be in advance and in full. I decided to accept the offer of treatment and before making payment, a tablet was handed to me with a document open, requesting my signature. The document outlined (and this is key) that results are not guaranteed. This is understandable given the nature of hair loss and results can vary dependant on health, lifestyle and even genetics. It's also worth mentioning at this point that there is a strict 'no refund policy'. I'd like to point out at this moment that given you are forced to pay in advance for treatment and the fact that it is concurrent ongoing treatments, the 'no refund policy' is not legally binding. This is because you are paying in advance for a product or in this case, treatment that you have not yet received. If you demand a refund for any treatment you have not yet received, this request should not be denied and furthermore, will not stand up in court. This brings me to my final point.I contacted Este Medical Group in relation to personal circumstances, explained to them my situation and requested a refund for treatments I have not yet received. I was forwarded to someone who introduced themselves as part of the Este Medical Group resolutions team. After explaining my situation, the 'no refund policy' was immediately reiterated and told my request was unlikely, however the representative would speak to the London branch and come back to me. Our next conversation was very brief and was along the lines of 'unfortunately we cannot give you a refund'. 2 alternative options were presented: 1) Transfer the value of my treatments to someone else - essentially sell my credit. 2) Pause and resume treatments when I wish. Neither solutions given would have solved my issue.As mentioned previously, the 'no refunds policy' isn't legally binding, I'm currently in conversation with legal representation to enforce a basic legal right to be reimbursed for a product or service not received.I would tread very carefully with this company, they are obviously well-versed in a hard sell and once they have your money, there is no letting go. Demand pay-per-session to steer clear of money kidnapping. The outcome of treatments are still to be proven. This business operates in a classic 'looks great on the outside', but fundamental good business practices are non-existent.

title: The magnesium put me in hospital
review: I bought Magnesium as recommended by Dr Gupta for palpitations, but it made my symptoms 100x worse. I ended up with seriously bad diarrhoea which made me extremely dehydrated which then made me tachycardic. My heart rate was at 170bpm! I was taken to hospital and hooked up to heart monitors given medication to bring my HR down and IV drip for the dehydration. All in all, it was a really traumatic experience! Oh and this was after taking HALF the dose recommended on the packet! After blood tests ruled out any infection, the Doctor told me it was the magnesium that caused the diarrhoea and it’s a very common side effect. I think it’s important for people with POTS like me to know this information as we really have to avoid being dehydrated due to low blood volume.

description:
WHY COMBAT FUEL?
Combat Fuel is a supplement company founded by a veteran of the British Army. It is our aim to supply supplements of the highest standard to aid any type of physical training.


SUPPLEMENT YOUR EVERY DAY WITH OUR SPECIFICALLY ENGINEERED FORMULAS THAT ARE 100% MILITARY AND ATHLETE SAFE.


OUR PROMISE
You categorically will not fail a CDT (Compulsory Drugs Test) with our products. All formulations are our own; we know what works and what doesn’t, backed by years of scientific research to deliver you the highest-quality supplements available. From pre-workouts to whey and vegan protein powders, we have it all, and at excellent prices, there is no reason not to choose Combat Fuel.


OUR FOUNDER
Combat Fuel was founded by Alex Berezynskyj, a veteran of the British army who, unfortunately, was medically discharged. After leaving the military, Alex was aided by the charity Help for Heroes during his recovery. As a direct result of this, he initially pledged 5% of Combat Fuel’s profits to Help for Heroes. In doing so raising thousands upon thousands for the charity. As the company evolves Alex’s charitable work has seen Combat Fuel broaden its reach to support many more military charities such as REORG.


Fast forward several years, Alex and the Combat Fuel team continue to innovate and grow the brand aiming to offer the highest-quality supplements available.

Not ones to do anything by half, back in 2017 we did it the hard way- we learnt how to produce all our own products in our ISO level 7 cleanrooms rather than buying them in from another company, as many other CBD 'manufacturers’ do. After a short while we saw our opening, and realised people want variety, they want flavour, they want great quality and even better value and most of all they want the sort of customer service you’d expect at Buckingham Palace!

Off the back of this, in March 2018, CBD Asylum was born- the tastiest, friendliest, cheapest, best quality, and now the most trusted CBD outfit ever to grace the CBD industry!!

At CBD Asylum, our customer service guys Tony and Kat simply cannot do enough for you- whether it’s an order query or just some friendly advice- they’re always in the shop or at the end of the phone.

What about every company saying they have great deals? Well with our frankly ridiculous offers like ‘Buy One Get Two Free’, nobody can beat us on value.

Surely our quality is lower than other brands because we’re so much cheaper? No way, Jose! All our products are third-party tested and everything is manufactured in-house in our lab to ensure absolute quality from plant to bottle! Nothing is bought from other manufacturers, this is how we keep the prices low and the quality high.

“But every company says they’re the best in the industry” I hear you say. True, but we can prove it! We’re the top rated CBD company on the worlds leading consumer review site- Trustpilot!

So check out the largest, most flamboyant, most colourful, tastiest, cheapest and best quality variety of CBD products that anyone has to offer.

description: The world's best water distillers
title: Excellent
review: Purchased the Deluxe Water Distiller for our family, two adults and two children under ten. After two months of daily use, our children now ask for distilled water rather than standard water. Excellent machine, very straight forward to use. Distilling takes approximately five and a half to six hours to complete but worth the wait, as we’re already noticing how distilled water is more thirst quenching than tap water. Customer service lady we spoke to was very helpful/ informed and gave sound advice. We were advised replacement parts can be obtained from Megahome if required. Well worth the investment if you can do so - don’t trust what water companies are supplying to your home!!!

They helped diagnose the issue over the phone and sent me detailed instructions of how to fixt it and what part I needed to buy. VERY IMPRESSED!

description: The world's best water distillers
title: My 316 Deluxe Water Distiller arrived…
review: My 316 Deluxe Water Distiller arrived on time secured in very strong boxes. I’ve been using it every other day now for two weeks, and am very impressed with this product. The residue left behind after each distillation  makes one wonder what have we been putting in to our bodies. I live in a very hard water area and have previously used water filters which were only really effective for two and a half weeks before the kettle started to build up lime scale.  I also bought bottled spring water. Both products were becoming quite expensive and I don’t wish to continue buying plastic even though it is recyclable. I thoroughly recommend this item to those who wish for a healthier lifestyle.

description: The world's best water distillers
title: All good
review: Got a new thermal cutout switch for my distiller. Works perfect, mounted on aluminium bracket with heat transfer compound supplied. When fitting this switch make sure it lines both up horizontally AND vertically with the button on the outside. In my case I had to bend the aluminium bracket slightly to get vertical alignment with switch button when fully assembled. Work smarter than me and check this BEFORE you put the thermal grease on it.

description: The world's best water distillers

review: At this moment it feels slightly premature to write a review as we have only had the 316 Deluxe Distiller from 10.11.21. However, so far all is as I would of expected and it does what it says on the tin. I think in the interest of transparency a proper review will be more appropriate in serval months time so as not to mislead people by either underrating or overrating this product. At the moment I think if anyone is looking to buy this product then know that they are the market leaders and that this product comes with a total of three years warranty. You may also purchase an additional three years which should offer you the peace of mind if anything were to happen to it. Sorry I can’t be more helpful. When I called the seller I was told that water comes through metalic pipes etc, and they had detoxed for a month on vit C and now the water tastes fine.  Not sure why they think that would make any difference! Distilled water should be odourless and without taste, the water from this distiller obviously was not. Dissapointed in the product,  I had my money refunded without quible however which is good practice.

description: The world's best water distillers

review: One of my friends recommended this distiller and I bought it with cheaper price £160 my friend bought it at the price of nearly £200. The function of the machine is not bad , it’s a bit noisy and takes at least 6-7 hours to finish the process ,for the first use I done it at night but I am thinking to use it when I’m not at home , still don’t know if it’s safe to leave it alone . The reason of buying this machine was I think it gives us purest water. Shipping was fast . If you don’t mind the taste of water I recommended to buy , the taste is not that pure.

title: Sticky labels on ziplock bags are TOO sticky
review: Zipvit recommend the choice of ziplock bags (rather than plastic bottles) to hold their tablets/capsules. Now, the new adhesive sticks enthusiastically to the surface of the plastic bag, making it almost impossible to remove the label cleanly, and leaving a sticky surface if this can be done.  In consequence, the whole thing just gets thrown away and wasted.A simple reversion to the easy-releasing adhesive of yester year would be SO much greener...

I got no further response, so had to check a couple of days later to see if the issue was fixed and delete the items that had been held in my basket. IT could do better!

description: Zipvit is a family owned UK company, dedicated to supplying vitamins and supplements for more than 25 years.

description: Zipvit is a family owned UK company, dedicated to supplying vitamins and supplements for more than 25 years.

title: Awful packaging
review: I need to complain about the whitening powder.  After removing from the box I unscrewed the lid and found that the plastic seal was impossible to remove.  The tag that you "pull" was useless!  I tried and tried and ended up breaking my nails and cutting my finger as I had to use a tool to prise open the white seal.  I wonder if others have experienced this issue?  The White sealing lid that sits on top of the powder is important to keep our moisture in my opinion, but it should not be so difficult that the customer cannot lift it off to get to use the powder.  No Patrick that advice did not help as I did all of that.  The seal was wedged in very tight and the seal was too small to get a grip.  I am an artist and dress maker, so very good with my hands.  I have opened many things in my life time but this took "the biscuit!"  No one should have to struggle and use an implement to get to the product, to remove the seal.  Take my advice seriously and look into this design fault so it can be improved, otherwise risk people not returning to buy this product.  I only hope that now I have brought this to people's attention,  other people will come forward and complain.  Perhaps the tab needs to be bigger, longer or have a different texture,  so it can be grabbed and pulled and do the job it was meant to do!!  It is a simple resolve.  I genuinely struggled and hurt my finger in doing so.  I don't need instructions on how to open a product.  The product was faulty and resulted in an injury.  I am not asking for a refund, but I am asking for this to be seriously considered.  A little lip or groove in the seal may help, not placing it on a table!!

title: Next day delivery who?
review: I’ve ordered a few times from Beauty Bay now and while I cannot fault the items or the secure packaging, the delivery service leaves very little to be desired. I often purchase more than enough to secure free next day delivery with them or on one occasion, I even paid for the next day service as I was in need of the item quickly, and I can safely say that not ONCE have I ever received a next day delivery service. The item is dispatched on the same day as expected, but never do they follow through with the promise of the next day service. I’m always later that day after dispatch met with an email stating the following;“Our warehouse have sadly advised that this order could not be processed for Next Day delivery, so this will now be sent out on a UK Tracked basis.”And lo and behold, my “Next day” order is sent via Evri 2 Day delivery and my items don’t arrive on time. If you cannot or do not wish to fulfil next day delivery, simply do not offer it as an option.

title: Ridiculous customer 'service' and lack of organization
review: I'd ordered from CB a few times before and never had an issue. Once I did, I was shocked at just HOW many bad reviews there are online...except for here on Trustpilot for some reason. Probably because companies have an easier time getting negative reviews removed from here than anywhere else - something TP is infamous for.So I ordered a couple of things for Christmas - where one thing was the main event and the other a little extra impulse buy. I would never have ordered just for the other one. A few hours later, I got an email from CB, telling me the thing I wanted was cancelled because it couldn't be shipped (could've just mentioned that before checkout when I entered my destination, but OK). In that case, I wanted to cancel the whole thing - which, according to *their* policy, is my right, no questions asked. Except...- when I replied to the email, it bounced back.- when I found another customer service email on their site and emailed it directly, it gave me an automated "we no longer monitor this address" reply.- when I tried the chat function on the site (many, many times), it didn't work. - when I went to my orders and tried to manually cancel (many, many times), it wouldn't let me.- when I sent a message through the website's messenger, they only replied two days later - at which point they told me it was too late to cancel since the order was already processed.The message I got back, BTW, told me it was now too late to cancel the order so I should return the item - basically, do their job for them. As if I have nothing better to do than print out labels and send post I didn't even want in the first place!Now the real kicker - yesterday I got an email that my package was stuck in customs (even though it shipped from EU to EU?) and that I'd have to go there myself and probably also pay a toll. Because, obviously, why wouldn't I pay extra for the opportunity to receive something I'VE SAID MULTIPLE TIMES I DON'T WANT, and then pay again just to send it back?The HUT group has awful customer 'service', and I'd advise to just stay away. You might not always bump into problems (I didn't until recently), but if you do - you're completely on your own. Zero interest in helping you or even making sense. Their deals are good but not worth that kind of hassle.[UPDATE on 29/12/24: surprisingly, CB reached out to me and rectified the situation. I appreciate the involvement, although I do sometimes question companies who only rectify after the customer has complained in public. Tentatively upping my review to 4* for now.]

title: Ordered a month ago, still haven’t received my package
review: I have bought from refy 2 times. First time everything was great, and the product were good. This time, i havent even recieved my package. I ordered it a month ago and have been in contact with the support system, but there keeps coming problems up. First I didn’t receive a order confirmation, then I didn’t receive a tracking number. And when they gave me my tracking number and I tracked my order, I can now see that it just goes from Amsterdam to England all the time on repeat, and it should be delivered to Denmark. What is going on refy, and why aren’t you answering me!

description:
We built Glaize (literally in the middle of a global pandemic and against all odds) because we think it's BS that getting a quality manicure has to take so much time and effort (regardless of whether you're doing it yourself or at the salon).


We exist to give you an alternative that's easier, faster and better for your nails and the environment while still giving you the durability and salon quality of a gel manicure. Call it a first world problem but who doesn't love a great mani?

Creating a long-lasting stick-on manicure that is made from and looks like real gel but doesn't need any curing once on the nail is no mean feat.

We spent over 2 years developing our formulations and continuously enhance them based on your feedback and by incorporating new bio-based ingredients into our formulations.

It only took about 600 attempts but we got there in the end.

We also ethically manufacture all our gels in our factory here in the UK and have our very own brilliant formulation chemist.
title: Absolute game changer
review: I was sceptical of all the reviews regarding the ease of use and longevity of the nails. I’m 66 years old, not great at painting my own nails and cannot afford to get them done regularly. Well what a game changer! I am recommending to everyone I know, it takes me less than 10 minutes to apply, they look amazing, lasted 16 days (could’ve lasted longer but fancied a change of colour) and so gentle and simple to remove. Will be ordering more.

Only things to be aware of, takes a little time to get used to putting on nails at right angle and central. Needed to trim two nails as ends of stick on nails catching but that could be me needing a little more practice to put on.I haven't taken them off yet but can see it will be much easier than removing gels.Also, even though I keep being told gels don't damage nails, from the first time of having gels ( had them 3 times) my nail base is dry and my nails constantly split - could be a coincidence. title: Nice product, chaotic and disappointing service
review: Overall the products are good, as they offer a well priced option for gel nails that are safe and super easy. It generally takes about 25 minutes to do, and my nails are in great condition after using them. However, no matter how expertly I file the ends and follow the instructions, the gels when filed do come up every so slightly short at the edge which means over time the tips of your nail underneath shows. If you file your nail down to the seam, it will ruin the gels. So you just have to live with it. This doesn’t bother me, but it’s important to note it won’t be a seamless look which might be annoying to others.I have had problems with my orders, and unfortunately haven’t had the best experience with customer service. I was recently sent nails in a completely different shape - I think I was sent toe nails sets instead of my custom made to measure finger nails sets. I sent pictures in to show how completely different the sets are by shape, and I absolutely cannot use the two sets sent to me. Customer service was dismissive, first suggesting I need to re-size each individual nail for future orders (no help to be given with the current order). Further trying to demonstrate that the nails are just more like toe nails and not finger nails in shape, it was additionally blamed on me for ordering a different length and I didn’t feel they were listening or trying to resolve my issues- they just wanted me to accept the nails that won’t fit and hope next time they’ll fit better. It felt as though they were suggesting it was entirely my fault if I’m getting the sizing wrong, even though it’s really hard to know how any edits will actually come out (if they didn’t send me toe nails instead of finger nails, then I’m under the impression that if you resize 1 nail they apply those changes to all the nails, given how wildlydifferent the sets sent me was and what customer service has suggested) and I was hoping for support in helping to get it right. Additionally, the subscription service is really complicated to pick out different colours each time, and if your colour is sold out before your subscription hits you aren’t notified, it just sends the other ones - thus making your subscription more expensive (as you don’t get the same price). Overall a really good product, let down by chaotic quality control and poor service.
